info.name: EventHubAPI - E2E
info.description:
## EventHubAPI — End-to-End Test

This collection validates the complete user journey through the EventHub API by executing a sequenced set of requests that mirror real-world usage — from account registration through event creation, booking management, and final cleanup.

All requests are currently organized within the **Event Bookings Business Flow** folder and are intended to be run in order as a single collection run.

To add more test flows (e.g. admin workflows, multi-user scenarios, or payment flows) can be added as separate folders following the same pattern.

---

### Current E2E Flow: Event Bookings Business Flow

The flow executes the following steps in sequence:

**1\. Authentication**

- Register a new user account
    
- Log in and capture the auth token
    
- Verify the authenticated user's identity
    

**2\. Event Management**

- Create a new event
    
- Retrieve the event by ID
    
- Update the event (`BUG-001` regression)
    
- Re-fetch the event after update to verify changes (`BUG-001`)
    
- Delete the event
    
- Confirm the event is no longer accessible
    

**3\. Booking Management**

- Create a booking for the event
    
- Retrieve the booking by ID
    
- Look up the booking by reference code
    
- List all bookings (with pagination and optional status filter)
    
- Create a booking at maximum ticket capacity
    
- List all bookings again to verify state
    
- Cancel a booking
    
- Retrieve the cancelled booking by ID to confirm status
    
- List all bookings filtered by `cancelled` status (`BUG-005` regression)
    

---

### Extensibility

This collection is structured to support additional E2E flows. Suggested flows to add in future iterations:

- **Admin / Organizer Flow** — event approval, capacity management, reporting
    
- **Multi-User Booking Flow** — concurrent bookings from different user accounts
    
- **Edge Case Flow** — overbooking attempts, invalid inputs, expired tokens
    
- **Full Lifecycle Flow** — create → book → update → cancel → delete in one pass
    

Add new flows as separate folders within this collection, following the same sequential execution pattern.

item.description:
This folder validates the complete end-to-end EventHub business workflow, covering user registration, login, authenticated user retrieval, event creation, booking creation, booking lookup, booking listing, event updates, booking cancellation, and event deletion.

The requests are organized to simulate a real customer journey through the system, using shared collection variables to pass generated user, event, booking, and reference code data between steps. It also includes validation points for known defect scenarios, such as event update behavior and cancelled booking filtering.
